# tally

Command-line timesheet for freelancers.

    tally start <project>
    tally stop
    tally report --week
files.docs/design.md:
# Design notes

## Storage

Time entries are appended to `~/.tally/entries.json`, one JSON array per user.
No database: a flat file is easy to back up and to edit by hand.

files.docs/storage.md:
# Storage

Supersedes the Storage section of docs/design.md.

## Concurrent writes

Running `tally start` in two terminals at once rewrote entries.json twice and lost one entry.
A flat JSON file cannot be written safely by two processes, so entries move to a SQLite database with WAL mode, which serialises writers for us.

events.message: feat(storage): keep time entries in SQLite
feat(report): weekly report starting on Monday
events.why: Weeks start on Monday because clients invoice on ISO weeks.

events.title: Fix midnight entries in the wrong week
events.what: An entry running past Sunday midnight was counted entirely in the next week, so the weekly totals were wrong before the client report could build on them.

events.message: fix(time): split entries that cross midnight
events.why: Entries crossing midnight were counted in the wrong week, so they are split at the day boundary.

events.title: M2 Invoicing
events.what: Turn tracked hours into per-client invoices.

events.why: Hours are grouped by project because retainer clients pay against a per-project budget.
